text:
Lina (Docs): Hey team — quick sweep on the Welcome Starter Kit quickstart. SDK v8 changed the auth init pattern and the Node + Python snippets are out of sync with our new minimal OAuth helper. I opened a PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5123. Can people sanity-check code and the short auth explainer?

Matt (Eng): Taking a look at the Node snippet now. Noting the old example used RW_API_KEY env var; v8 wants RW_TOKEN and the constructor name changed.

Sophie (DevEx): We should keep both minimal token snippet and an OAuth section. Many newcomers expect simple env var; but we must call out why OAuth is preferred for production. Suggest 1-line note + link to the OAuth guide.

Jamie (SDK): FYI the SDK alias is now 'Redwood' not 'RedwoodClient' — the PR should update import lines. Also changed streaming API shape a bit.

Lina (Docs): Good catch. Current PR updates imports, code blocks, and one image (auth-flow.png) but I haven't updated the OAuth link anchor.

Matt (Eng): Quick code nits — replace this old block in Node section:

```js
// old
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' });
```

with:

```js
// recommended v8 minimal token flow
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN });
const out = await client.generate({ input: 'hello world' });
```

Sophie (DevEx): Also add a 1-line note under the snippet: "For production, use the OAuth helper (recommended) or the CLI ephemeral token flow — see link below."

Jamie (SDK): Python snippet parity: change class name to Redwood, and example for context/streaming should show `with client.stream(...) as s:` pattern. I'll post a quick diff.

Lina (Docs): I'm going to tweak the prose too — remove first-person tutorial language in the intro, keep it neutral and concise.

Matt (Eng): I ran the commands in a temp env, everything compiles. Found one more outdated link that points to /docs/auth-old — should point to /docs/auth/oauth.

Lina (Docs): Thanks. I'll update the link anchors in the PR. Can someone do a quick visual check of the updated auth-flow.png? It's in the PR assets.

Jamie (SDK): I previewed the image — looks good but can we annotate the OAuth exchange step with a short label: "app -> auth server: request code"? Small tweak.

Sophie (DevEx): Also adding a micro-example of choosing between token vs. OAuth: two bullets with short tradeoffs. I'll push to the PR branch.

docs-bot: PR #5123 created by Lina (Docs) — CI checks queued.

deploy-bot: Netlify preview for branch docs/welcome-auth available at https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/5123

Matt (Eng): Left a couple of line comments on the PR explaining the import change and the README consistency.

Lina (Docs): Awesome. Plan: merge after CI passes + one more SDK ack. Targeting EOD today. If anyone wants to weigh in on wording, ping me here.

Sophie (DevEx): I'll add the OAuth callout and update the text for clarity. :thumbsup:

Jamie (SDK): LGTMed from SDK side. :eyes:

Matt (Eng): ✅

Lina (Docs): Thanks all — I'll do a final pass once the CI artifacts and preview deploy are green.
